[P2] Align companion release pins with the built artifacts

The testing and telemetry packages still obtain their versions from unchanged `__about__.py` values `1.3.0` and `0.0.1`; testing also still declares Core `>=2.1.0`. The publishing workflow builds those files directly, so releasing this tree will not produce the companion versions required by this table and the installation command. Align the instructions with compatible release artifacts, or include the companion version and dependency updates needed to publish the advertised versions.
